briefdescription.para: Connection parameters for the PostgreSQL database (and the database executor).

detaileddescription.para:
Reads DB_* variables with Defaults::Database fallbacks. A zero max_conn is auto-sized to hardware_concurrency()*5 by the constructor; the same sizing is applied independently in DbExecutorConfig. Credentials are never logged.
The shipped pass default is an insecure development placeholder; override DB_PASS in any non-test deployment.
